label: IFEval
description: Verifiable instruction-following benchmark requiring a dedicated versioned rule evaluator.

governance.decision_notes: License evidence, dataset/evaluator boundaries, and the dedicated scoring contract require fixed-revision review.

license.review_notes: Upstream declarations are recorded but not yet verified for a pinned dataset and evaluator revision.

official_comparability.notes: Requires a pinned or equivalent official evaluator and separate prompt-level and instruction-level strict/loose metrics.

blockers: Dataset and evaluator licenses are not human-verified at immutable revisions.
No immutable dataset or evaluator revision is pinned.
Artifact URL, format, SHA-256, byte count, and size limit are not pinned.
Dedicated instruction-rule scorer, metric contract, converter, splits, profiles, and prompt version are not fixed.
Official evaluator parity is not established.
